sarah-cs: heads-up: PioneerHealth pilot dropped nightly embed jobs to ~25% activity overnight. flagging for renewal-watch.
ravi-am: any infra errors? devon, did enablement change prompts recently?
devon-csm: only minor prompt wording. champion (Leah) is out; Marta is stepping in for procurement and paused heavy jobs citing noisy outputs and rising cost.
alice-eng: quick triage: observed reranker ordering flips after last model rollout. small repro:
```
baseline v2.4 -> [A,B,C]
v4.0 rollout -> [B,A,C]
```
alice-eng: pinning PioneerHealth traffic to v2.4 now. starting canary.
ops-bot: job-4512: routing pin applied to 2 canary hosts. health checks running.
sarah-cs: i'll update Marta and offer a 20-min QA walkthrough. can we confirm cost delta v2.4 -> v4.0 for them?
ravi-am: on it. also drafting a softened renewal offer if they stay after pilot: 1-week credit + priority debugging.
marta-procurement: appreciate the quick fix. we'll resume nightly runs once you confirm ordering stable. need note on fallback behavior for future rollouts.
devon-csm: will DM a short checklist (5 smoke prompts + expected ordering + where to check logs).
ops-bot: canary healthy. rolling to remaining hosts (ETA ~8m).
alice-eng: post-pin checks pass on our 30-case set. blocking v4.0 for A/B rerank until eval done.
sarah-cs: sent update to Marta. scheduled 30m QA in 90m. marking renewal-watch and pairing CSM+AM. :thumbsup:
